properties.name: Mother Teresa Hall, Yerwada
properties.source: https://www.freepressjournal.in/pune/pune-why-do-homeless-people-refuse-shelter-homes-despite-the-bitter-cold (Dec 24, 2024); corroborated by https://www.punekarnews.in/pune-provides-shelter-food-to-its-homeless-needy-people-and-students/ (Mar 27, 2020, naming 'Mother Teresa Hall, Yerawada' as the specific site)
properties.notes: Nominatim resolved to the Yerwada locality centroid, not the specific Mother Teresa Hall building; no street address found. Point-in-polygon against this repo's wards.geojson (DataMeet 2012 76-prabhag set, numbered only, no ward names) places it in Ward 14. One of PMC's 5 current PMC-run SUH shelters (as of Dec 2024 reporting); men-only, 23-bed capacity per Free Press Journal.

properties.name: Dudh Bhatti / Samaj Mandir, Bopodi
properties.source: https://www.freepressjournal.in/pune/pune-why-do-homeless-people-refuse-shelter-homes-despite-the-bitter-cold (Dec 24, 2024); corroborated by https://www.punekarnews.in/pune-provides-shelter-food-to-its-needy-people-and-students/ (Mar 27, 2020, naming 'Dudh Bhatti - Samaj Temple, Bopodi')
properties.notes: Geocoded (via Photon/OSM) to the Bopodi locality centroid, not the specific temple/hall. Point-in-polygon places it in Ward 6 of this repo's wards.geojson. Men-only, 17-bed capacity per Free Press Journal, Dec 2024.

properties.name: Shivaji Nagar shelter (women)
properties.notes: Source names only the locality 'Shivaji Nagar', no street address; not present in the earlier (Mar 2020) PMC shelter list, so likely added later. Geocoded to the Shivaji Nagar locality centroid. Point-in-polygon places it in Ward 13. Women-only, 60-bed capacity — the largest single facility in PMC's current 5-shelter roster.

properties.name: Sena Dutta Police Chowky (Senadutt Cultural Hall, Senadutt Peth)
properties.source: https://www.freepressjournal.in/pune/pune-why-do-homeless-people-refuse-shelter-homes-despite-the-bitter-cold (Dec 24, 2024); corroborated by https://www.punekarnews.in/pune-provides-shelter-food-to-its-homeless-needy-people-and-students/ (Mar 27, 2020, naming 'Senadutt Cultural Hall, Senadutt Peth')
properties.notes: OSM/Photon returned a direct match: 'Senadatta Police Chowki', Pune — matching the source's 'Sena Dutta Police Chowky' landmark closely. Individual bed capacity not stated in either source; this site plus the Pune Station site together account for the remaining 109 of the 209-bed PMC total (209 minus Yerwada 23, Bopodi 17, Shivaji Nagar 60 = 109 combined, unattributed between these two).
